annotation.title_clean: 自然资源部 国家发展改革委 科技部 工业和信息化部 国家卫生健康委 市场监管总局 国家中医药局 国家药监局关于加快海洋药物和功能制品高质量发展的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Other Departments on Accelerating High-Quality Development of Marine Drugs and Functional Products
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 自然资源部; 国家发展改革委; 科技部; 工业和信息化部; 国家卫生健康委; 市场监管总局; 国家中医药局; 国家药监局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry guiding opinion (May 2026) on accelerating marine drugs and functional products. It covers resource supply, R&D innovation including an 'AI+marine drugs' effort, industrial clusters, market access, funding and talent. Targets industry value-added above 130 billion yuan by 2030. Not about embodied AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target of multiple marine innovative drugs launched and industry value-added above 130 billion yuan by 2030
Build marine drug resource banks and national deep-sea gene bank
Promote 'AI+marine drugs' with high-quality datasets and large models
Support industrial clusters in Shandong, Shanghai, Zhejiang and Fujian
Fund via central guidance, talent training and operational monitoring
